key.name: toggle-ormic-launcher
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open or close the Ormic Launcher dialog.

key.name: debug
key.description: Print verbose debug messages to the system journal.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the top panel search indicator icon.

key.name: max-results
key.description: How many results to show at once in the launcher.

key.name: custom-groups
key.summary: Custom user groups and their apps

key.name: background-style
key.description: Style of the dialog background (blur, transparent, or solid).

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Accent color used for highlights and selections. Choices: gnome, yellow, blue, purple, red, green, pink, teal, orange, slate.

key.name: grid-icon-size
key.description: Size of icons in the library grid view, in pixels (32–80). Controls card width/height and icon bin size proportionally.

key.name: launcher-width
key.description: Width of the floating launcher dialog in pixels (600–1600).

key.name: launcher-height
key.description: Height of the floating launcher dialog in pixels (400–1200).
